_source: POC Testing Data tab (AI Project prequalification vendor response.xlsx) rows 7-10, Hotel List.pdf, Room Info PDFs, Email Signature PDFs. Room catalog lists only the main room types used by the PoC scenarios; max occupancy is copied from the Room Info PDFs.

common_policy.child_meal_policy: At both city and resort hotels, when accompanied by a dine-in adult, up to 2 children of registered in-house hotel guests at the age of 6 and below can enjoy buffet meals at the all-day dining venues at no additional charge. Additional children at the age of 6 and below and all children who are above 6 years of age but under 12 years of age will receive a 50% discount on the adult buffet price. Children of registered walk-in guests under the age of 12 will receive a 50% discount on buffet meals at the all-day dining outlets.

cancellation_policy.FLEX: Cancellations made after 18:00 local hotel time, one day prior to arrival, will be subject to a one-night room charge, plus applicable service charges, taxes, and fees.
cancellation_policy.AP: Credit card prepayment for the full duration of the stay is required at the time of booking. Prepayment will not be refunded for cancellations. Amendment to reservations is not allowed.

payment_method.FLEX: Guest is required to provide a credit card to guarantee the reservation; the room rate will be charged upon check out.
payment_method.AP: A full prepayment is required upon reservation.

common_policy.booking_verification: For any reservation amendment, cancellation and reconfirmation, obtain the confirmation number from the guest and verify it with booking details (guest's name, mobile number, email address).
common_policy.recap_after_booking: Recap hotel name, confirmation number, guest's name, travelling dates, room types and total rate inclusive of taxes.
common_policy.upsell: While quoting: may upsell airport transfer, room decoration (special occasions such as wedding anniversary, birthday, honeymoon) and room upgrade. After a successful booking: upsell airport transfer, spa and F&B. Only upsell airport transfer if the guest is travelling by flight.
common_policy.special_request_rules: Only one extra bed or one baby cot per room. Inventory 3 units per hotel. All special requests are subject to availability; guaranteed requests may incur a charge per hotel policy. LOYALTY members get early check-in / late check-out per tier benefits.

mailboxes._comment: Maps the Connect email address the guest wrote to (local part prefix, case-insensitive) to a mailbox profile. The resource prefix added by deploy_week_N.sh (e.g. 'sl_' in sl_reservations@) is stripped first (env MAILBOX_PREFIX). The AI always replies from that same address ($.SystemEndpoint.Address).
